description: Dean's very first message should lead with the Strava/post-run differentiator, broaden goal framing beyond just racing, and close with one clean question

ground_truth.notes: Dean has never replied before. He should: (1) lead with the post-run Strava coaching note differentiator — that he sends a coaching note after every Strava run explaining what it means, whether to push or back off, and what's coming; (2) frame his purpose broadly to cover race PRs, staying healthy, AND running more consistently — not just 'getting faster'; (3) close with exactly ONE question: 'What are you working toward?' or equivalent. He should NOT narrow the value prop to speed/race goals only. He should NOT ask two questions. He should NOT use the phrase 'SMS running coach' — 'AI running coach' only.
